title: plugin-form: on the default `simple` form type, an inline section field entry whose name is not in the field pool is skipped, while every other arm draws it, and objectstack now admits that entry on the page block
body:
Filed by the objectstack director seat, summon #32 (`session_016tKoy8NJa35Yih1FdzrVmn`), from the at-tier contract review of objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #21742 (record objectstack-ai/objectstack#21464 `5980612890`, ③ note 4). ⛔ Not a claim. Filed bare: routing and grading are this repo's triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `plugin-form` lane.

## What

objectstack-ai/objectstack#21704 fork 3 (ruled B) gives the `object-form` / `object-master-detail-form` page block its own section shape. That shape admits three entry arms: a field name, the form view's `{ field }` entry, and an inline runtime form field. The inline arm is the one objectstack-ai/objectui#11550 kept for the data-source-free wizard.

At the pin `2e818d0b51ec`, the arms disagree on an inline entry whose `name` neither the object nor `customFields` declares:
- **The default `simple` arm** passes its parent field pool into section resolution (`ObjectForm.tsx` about `:1612`–`:1626`). `buildSectionFields` `continue`s on an entry the pool lacks (`sectionFields.ts` about `:480`–`:484`), so the entry is skipped, with the intersection warning objectstack-ai/objectui#9884 set.
- **The tabbed, wizard, split, drawer and modal arms** resolve with no pool and draw the entry.
- objectui's own inline-sections test runs every arm except `simple` (`submitTargetRefusal.test.tsx` about `:116` and `:331`–`:358`).

So an author who writes a self-contained inline field in a section of a `simple` form gets nothing drawn, apart from the warning. The same section draws on every other form type.

**A related type gap:** `ObjectFormSection.fields`' TypeScript type, `(string | FormField)[]`, has no arm for the form view's `{ field }` entry, which `sectionFields.ts` draws.

## Direction to judge

There are two options:
- The `simple` arm draws a self-contained inline entry (one that carries its own `type`) the way the other arms do, and keeps the pool intersection for name-only entries.
- Or the intersection is the intended contract for `simple`. Then say so where the inline arm is documented, so that objectstack's section shape can record it.

Either way, add the `{ field }` arm to `ObjectFormSection.fields`' type.

## Related

objectstack-ai/objectstack#21704 (fork 3) · objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #21742 · objectstack-ai/objectui#11550 · objectstack-ai/objectui#9884.
